'''Desnoy Ewok' deck 1''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Desnoy]]
* '''Published:''' 20 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif|label=There Is Good In Him}}
* '''Strategy:''' There Is Good In Him
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 TIGIH Desnoy LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck focus on ewok with the objective TIGIH, Ive won the first match I play with this deck, but I know it can be better, any suggestion will be appreciated

The published list has 58 cards.

== Strategy ==

Deploy every ewok you get, i usually put at least 3 ewok on each exterior site and I use ewok rescue ans thing like that to help in each battler

Rebel scout: use them to react in each combat if possible

Im usually able to drain at least 6 froces each turn and if the opponent deploy a lot on a single endor site, at 99% im able to bring all my caracter to this site so your chance of winning increase a lot
